title: Signed standard cohomology of coefficient Frobenius pairs
statement: Fix a purity setting P [def-pur-conventions] and a separated finite-type arithmetic scheme X_0 over its finite field [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. On the common-stage Frobenius-pair category [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], choose the finite-stage signed Roos shifts and their common-stage comparison with each finite-stage inclusion from [lem-pod-fixed-pair-truncation-cohomology]. Choose the truncLE and truncGE comparisons uniquely normalized by their counit and unit equations. Define canonicalCoefficientWeilCohomology in degree n as IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso of truncLE n, then truncGE n, then the normalized n-shift, with values lifted to the full standard Weil heart [def-weil-constructible-heart]. These values lie in the heart by the same truncation package. The underlying functor is precisely truncLE n followed by truncGE n followed by shift n; no identification with a native derived fixed-pair category is asserted.

proof.text: Use fixedPairCommonTruncationCohomology to retain both its finite-stage Roos normalization and the actual finite-stage inclusion shift equation. Its truncation comparisons are normalized by the counit and unit equations. Compose their IsoAlgebra.mapOfNatIso functors and the normalized shift; the heart-membership clause lifts this explicit functor to the full coefficient Weil heart. The finite-stage normalization determines the shift comparisons on all common-stage representatives and arrows; truncation uniqueness determines the other comparisons.
